Name: Talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits for Datable Jodi
Author: Doomphase
Description:
I was kind of itching for this mod to be made for a while and realized it'd be easy enough for me to do so I went and made it. Additional portraits are directly based off of BananaR1ce's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10507]talkohlooeys' portraits for dateable jodi[/url]. For all seasons but Spring, the hands in portrait 5 were removed as I don't actually have any sort of talent for this and was just replacing the appropriate faces.

To use them, simply replace the files in ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿ that correspond to Jodi with these ones.

Regarding the sprites: a few of the sprites added by datable Jodi won't match up even with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]seasonal cute outfits[/url] installed (such as the kissing animation and some heart event sprites), but hopefully one day someone makes compatible ones as it's beyond me.
